constraints.instruction: Do not morph, resize, bend, duplicate, relabel, or swap any part of the bottle or trigger between shots.
Do not show the carton before shot_endcard; when it appears in shot_endcard, do not change its structure, color, line illustration, or hierarchy.
No distorted, moving, duplicated, misspelled, or substituted AERIS wordmark.
No auto-captions, timestamps, scene labels, technical metadata, extra copy, or altered approved claim text.
No mist before the trigger press, mist from outside the nozzle, reverse motion, liquid teleportation, wet desk continuity error, or unsupported floating object.
No hand, fern, pot, desk grain, label seam, lighting direction, exposure, or product orientation drift between shots.
No whip pan, orbit, crash zoom, handheld shake, impossible focus jump, or unmotivated speed ramp.
No invented narration, sung words, extra trigger clicks, outdoor ambience, or sound without a visible or implied source unless explicitly approved nondiegetic music.
No performance percentage, health benefit, testimonial, popularity, rating, certification, sustainability, or comparison claim.
No storyboard frame, prompt panel, metadata sidebar, safe-zone guide, playback UI, progress bar, or annotation.
No provider watermark, tool branding, signature, URL, QR code, or stock mark.
